privacy.title: Privacy center
privacy.subtitle: What this app protects, and what no BitTorrent client can hide.

hero.vpnText: Every connection is bound to {iface}. If the VPN drops, transfers stop instantly — nothing can leak through your regular connection.
hero.proxyText: Peers and trackers see the proxy at {proxy}, not your IP. DHT, UDP and incoming connections are disabled so nothing bypasses it.
hero.directTitle: Your IP address is visible to peers
hero.directText: BitTorrent peers must know an address to send data to. Without a VPN or proxy, that is your real IP. Encryption and anonymous mode are on, but they cannot hide your address.
hero.offlineText: The protected connection is not available, so nothing is sent at all.

check.telemetryText: No analytics, crash reports, update pings or identifiers. The app never contacts its authors.
check.portableText: Settings live next to the .exe. Nothing is written to the registry.
check.appdataText: The app folder is read-only, so settings are stored in your user profile.
check.ipProxy: All peer and tracker traffic goes through {proxy}.
check.ipDirect: Not protected. Use a no-logs VPN that allows P2P, or a SOCKS5 proxy.
check.killText: Traffic cannot leave outside the VPN; transfers stop the moment it disconnects.
check.killNa: Available when traffic is bound to a VPN adapter.
check.dnsVpn: Tracker names are resolved through the VPN.
check.dnsProxy: Names are resolved by the proxy; local DNS lookups are blocked.
check.encryptionRequired: Only encrypted connections are allowed. Hides BitTorrent traffic from ISP throttling.
check.encryptionPreferred: Encrypted when the peer supports it. Unencrypted peers are still allowed.
check.fingerprintOn: Random peer ID, no client name or version in handshakes or tracker requests.
check.fingerprintOff: Peers and trackers can see which client you use.
check.webrtcText: WebTorrent uses WebRTC, which can reveal your real IP. It is permanently disabled.
check.upnpOn: UPnP asks your router to open a port, which announces the app on your network.
check.dhtOn: Finds peers without trackers, but DHT nodes see your IP and which torrents you look up.
check.dhtOff: Peers are found through trackers only.
check.historyOn: Your transfer list is stored only on this computer.
check.historyOff: Nothing about your transfers is kept after you exit.
check.linksText: Magnet links cannot make the app contact your local network, use WebRTC, or crash it with malformed tracker URLs.
check.execOn: Executables and disguised file names are highlighted before you download.
check.motwOn: Downloaded files are marked as coming from the Internet, so Windows SmartScreen checks them.
check.blocklistOff: No blocklist loaded. Note that blocklists offer limited protection.

limits.title: Honest limits
limits.item1: Any peer you exchange data with learns the IP address you connect from. Only a VPN or proxy changes that address.
limits.item2: A VPN provider can see your traffic. Choose one with an audited no-logs policy that permits P2P.
limits.item3: Private trackers may require client identification; turn off anonymous mode if a tracker asks for it.
limits.item4: Privacy tools do not make copyright infringement legal. Respect the laws of your country.

settings.title: Settings
settings.startImmediatelyHint: When off, new transfers are added paused.
settings.warnExecutablesHint: Highlights programs, scripts and disguised names before you download.
settings.markOfTheWeb: Mark downloaded files as from the Internet
settings.markOfTheWebHint: Lets Windows SmartScreen and Office Protected View check them. No source address is recorded.
settings.rememberTorrentsHint: When off, the transfer list and resume data are deleted when you exit.
settings.seedAfterCompleteHint: Sharing back keeps torrents alive for everyone.
settings.seedRatioLimitHint: 0 means seed until you stop it.
settings.listenPortHint: Incoming connections reach this port. Disabled in proxy mode.
settings.randomizePort: Use a new random port on every launch
settings.dhtHint: Finds peers without trackers. DHT nodes can see your IP. Disabled in proxy mode.
settings.pexHint: Learn about peers from other peers.
settings.utpHint: Congestion-friendly UDP transport. Disabled in proxy mode.
settings.ipv6Hint: Turn off if your VPN does not tunnel IPv6.
settings.upnpHint: Asks your router to open the port. Off by default for privacy; never used with a VPN or proxy.
settings.webSeedsHint: Download from HTTP mirrors listed in the torrent. They follow the same VPN or proxy rules.
settings.encryptionPreferHint: Encrypt when possible, allow unencrypted peers.
settings.encryptionRequireHint: Only encrypted peers. Hides traffic from ISP throttling; slightly fewer peers.
settings.anonymousModeHint: Random peer ID; no client name or version is sent to peers or trackers.
settings.modeDirectHint: Peers and trackers see your real IP address.
settings.modeVpnHint: Recommended. All traffic is locked to the VPN; a built-in kill switch stops transfers if it drops.
settings.modeProxyHint: Peer and tracker traffic goes through the proxy. DHT, uTP and incoming connections are disabled.
settings.vpnInterfaceHint: Connect your VPN first, then pick its adapter.
settings.autoReconnect: Resume automatically when the VPN reconnects
settings.autoReconnectHint: When off, press Reconnect in the Privacy center after the VPN is back.
settings.proxyPassNote: Stored encrypted with Windows DPAPI; only your Windows account can read it.
settings.blocklistHint: P2P plaintext format, optionally .gz. Read locally; nothing is downloaded.

support.title: Support the project
support.lead: This app is free and always will be: no ads, no tracking, no paid tiers. If it is useful to you, a donation helps keep development going.
support.bmcText: One-off or monthly support with a card.
support.kofiText: Card or PayPal, no account needed.
support.daText: Cards and popular payment methods in the CIS.
support.note: Links open in your browser. Donation platforms have their own privacy policies; this app sends them nothing.
support.other1: Tell a friend who cares about privacy.
support.other3: Help translate the app into your language.
support.thanks: Thank you for supporting free and private software.

about.title: About
about.promise1: No telemetry, analytics or crash reporting — ever.
about.promise2: No accounts, no ads, no bundled software.
about.promise3: One portable .exe. Delete the folder and it is gone.
about.licenseText: Torrent is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. It comes with absolutely no warranty. You may redistribute and modify it under the terms of that license.
about.legal: This software is a general-purpose BitTorrent client provided as is, without warranty. You are responsible for what you download and share. Respect copyright and the laws of your country.
